items.q: Q: Do I have to be home for the whole cleanout?
a: A: Only for the twenty-minute walkthrough and your approval — after that, presence is optional. Many Whitby clears run while the household is at work: we sort carefully, set aside anything significant, send photo updates on request, and lock up as arranged. You come home to, empty space.

items.q: Q: Can you work around commuter hours — early mornings, evenings, weekends?
a: A: It’s the core of how we schedule here. No premium for any of it.

items.q: Q: The basement has been "next weekend's project" for three years. How long does it actually take you?
a: A: Usually a few hours — that’s the anticlimax. A typical Whitby basement or garage clears; full homes generally finish within a day, trucks cycling as needed. The walkthrough gives you an honest timeline, not a hopeful one.

items.q: Q: Can we split the job across weekends?
a: A: Absolutely, with no penalty — the garage this Saturday, the basement after March break. {{fact:changedScope}}.
